entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I think I need to make a return? I have this helmet and I'm just so confused by everything.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could I get your name and order number, please?
It's Sarah Miller, and the order number is... um... VF88-12-901.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your order for the Aero Road Helmet. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a personal preference?

Oh, I don't know. It's just... the website showed one thing, and the color seems different. I haven't even taken it out of the packaging, the box is unopened. I'm just worried about safety and visibility now. The whole process was just... a lot. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help you, Sarah. It's important you're completely happy with your gear. Let me just pull up our current return policy for you. One moment.
Okay, I've got it here. It looks like your helmet was delivered 78 days ago. According to our policy, we accept returns on standard items for up to 90 days from the delivery date.
Oh, really? So I can return it?

Yes, absolutely. You are well within the 90-day window, so I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file right now. You should receive it in the next few minutes.
Wow, okay! That's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, David. That's much easier than I thought it would be.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
